purpose: Validate semantic correctness of OpenFHE/FIDESlib relinearization on controlled 3-part coefficient ciphertexts. This isolates Algorithm 3 line5 KS_{s^2->s}.

warning.value: Uses secret key to construct c0 = m - c2*s^2. Not secure.
warning.zh: 该脚本用 secret key 构造 3-part 输入，只用于验证 relinearization 语义。

global_decision.next_goal: Relinearization does not preserve nonzero c2 semantics; inspect relinearize_coeff_ct / key switching.
global_decision.zh: 只有 c2=0 通过，说明 relinearize 对 raw-imported c2 语义不正确。
